CustomField.description: This field will validate that the amount of proceeds that we expect from the lender matches the calc net proceeds field.
CustomField.formula: IF( ROUND(Discount_PV_For_Actual__c - Actual_Equip_Cost__c - Lender_Doc_Fee_For_Actual__c - Actual_Fee_1_Amt__c - Actual_Fee_2_Amt__c - Lost_Margin_For_Actual__c - Actual_Split_Margin__c - Int_Settlement_For_Actual__c,2) = ROUND(Calc_Net_Proceeds_For_Actual__c,2), "True", "False")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will validate that the amount of proceeds that we expect from the lender matches the calc net proceeds field.
CustomField.label: Proceeds Validation
